title: Thus Spoke the Rabbit
titleNative: うさぎはかく語りき
synopsis: Once known as a bustling and chaotic city of youth, Shibugaya has become a ghost town ever since man-eating rabbits took up residence underground… But in the face of such danger, wolf girl Izuko, with her bunny-girl friend by her side, arrives on the scene to take on the underground! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Hai Kouen no Homeless Seijo
titleNative: 廃公園のホームレス聖女
synopsis: One day, 15-year-old saint Alm decides she can no longer stand her boss's power harassment and runs out of the temple. She buys land in an abandoned park, builds a barrier around a bench, and begins a homeless life where she can sleep freely, create food using her holy power, and enjoy the comfortable slow life in the park. On the other hand, the temple, which has lost their saint and is no longer able to function, is in a frenzy! (Source: SB Creative, translated)

title: Pura Pura Chicketta
titleNative: ぷらぷらチッケッタ
synopsis: Mamiana is the perfect example of a lonely office worker. One day, while eating her lunch alone in the park during her lunch break, she happens upon her unapproachable senior colleague, Yato, having fun on the swings and kicking shoes...!? She is joined by Haniya, a woman in her 30s dressed as a maid, and the three "big kids" wander around the neighborhood, reverting to their childhood. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: LOST MAN
titleNative: LOST MAN
synopsis: There lives a man who has lost his memory and can’t remember where he’s from, and who he is, including his name. He just goes by the name Matsumoto and the one and only thing he remembers is how to play soccer. However, the one thing he does remember, he does exceptionally well, even better than the professionals. He sells his ridiculous soccer skills to teams and guarantees them goals and, even more important, wins. As he travels from city to city, country to country playing for money, he hopes that he regains his memory.

title: Mimi's Tales of Terror
titleNative: ミミの怪談
synonyms: Las historias de fantasmas de Mimi
synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito! Chapter 1: On the Utility Pole Chapter 2: The Woman Next Door Chapter 3: Rustling in the Grass Chapter 4: Grave Placement Chapter 5: Seashore Chapter 6: Just the Two of Us Chapter 7: Scarlet Circle Chapter 8: Sign in the Field Chapter 9: Monster Prop (Source: VIZ Media)

synopsis: Ryoichi Aikawa, an ordinary high school boy who’s crazy about fishing, helps the school’s Madonna, Misa Watanabe, when she’s being bothered by guys trying to pick her up by the seaside. A frustratingly sweet seaside romantic comedy featuring a single-minded, love-offensive JK and an unbelievably dense, iron-wall boy!

synonyms: Sono Na wa One Zero One
synopsis: The sequel to "Babel II" set a few years after Yomi's defeat. This time Babel's enemies are the US military and the CIA, who are interested in using Babel's power for their own nefarious purposes after Babel had given them a sample of his own blood to use for charitable purposes. Not only will Babel be forced to fight against adversaries endowed with his own powers, but he will also not be able to count on the help of his trusted companions, imprisoned in a place where not even his brainwaves can reach them. A true ending to Babel II, completely ignoring Part 4 of the original manga. Note: Includes one-shot "Point 4".
